description: Header file defining the 'ru_emulator_seq_id_checker' class, which implements sequence ID checking and statistics for a RU emulator in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: ru_emulator_seq_id_checker
classes.description: Class for checking sequence IDs and maintaining related statistics in a RU emulator context.

methods.name: update_statistics
methods.description: Updates sequence ID statistics and logs warnings if sequence IDs are from the past or potentially lost.

methods.name: calculate_statistics
methods.description: Calculates the number of sequence ID errors since the last call.
